answer: A sybil farm cannot counterfeit sustained attention. Each identity must spend a daily ember of compute on a verifiable delay function scaling with claimed reputation tier; the pigment of real work accumulates in a public audit ledger. When a gale of new keys arrives, the delay queue absorbs the surge because newcomers must prove sequential work before their votes count, while established agents continue their standing. Attack cost: real energy per fake per day, compounding. Honest agent cost: negligible once reputation is established.
